article.title: El infinitivo en las oraciones subordinadas de relativo
article.part: Formas no personales y perífrasis / Non-finite forms and periphrases

claims.sectionKey: El infinitivo puede encabezar una oración subordinada de relativo
claims.summary: The infinitive can head a subordinate relative clause, which is a non-personal clause related to a nominal antecedent.

claims.sectionKey: En No tengo nada que decir, la secuencia que decir se vincula con nada
claims.summary: In the phrase 'No tengo nada que decir', the relative 'que decir' is linked to 'nada'.

claims.sectionKey: En Tengo algo que leer, que leer modifica a algo
claims.summary: In the phrase 'Tengo algo que leer', the relative 'que leer' modifies 'algo'.

claims.sectionKey: En Buscamos un lugar donde descansar, donde descansar relacionado con un lugar
claims.summary: In the phrase 'Buscamos un lugar donde descansar', the relative 'donde descansar' is related to 'un lugar'.

claims.sectionKey: El infinitivo carece de flexión de persona
La presencia de un antecedente diferencia estas relativas de las subordinadas sustantivas de infinitivo
claims.summary: The presence of an antecedent distinguishes these relative infinitives from substantive infinitive relatives.

links.notes: The article explicitly states that the infinitive can head a subordinate relative clause, which is a non-personal clause related to a nominal antecedent. This claim is supported by the Real Academia Española's webpage on the cohesion and independence of components of verbal periphrases.

The article provides an example of the relative 'que' linking the subordinate clause 'que decir' to the antecedent 'nada' in the phrase 'No tengo nada que decir'. This claim is supported by the Real Academia Española's webpage on the cohesion and independence of components of verbal periphrases.

The article provides an example of the relative 'que' modifying 'algo' in the phrase 'Tengo algo que leer'. This claim is supported by the Real Academia Española's webpage on the cohesion and independence of components of verbal periphrases.

The article provides an example of the relative 'donde' linking the subordinate clause 'donde descansar' to the antecedent 'un lugar' in the phrase 'Buscamos un lugar donde descansar'. This claim is supported by the Real Academia Española's webpage on the cohesion and independence of components of verbal periphrases.

The article states that the infinitive lacks person inflection, which is a general claim about the infinitive form. This claim is supported by the Real Academia Española's webpage on the cohesion and independence of components of verbal periphrases.

The article distinguishes relative infinitives from substantive infinitive relatives by mentioning that the presence of an antecedent differentiates them. This claim is supported by the Real Academia Española's webpage on the cohesion and independence of components of verbal periphrases.
